description: A dead ogre animated into a slow hulking corpse, preserving the ogre's huge proportions while showing restrained unmistakable undeath. Huge heavy ogre frame with sagging posture, stiff joints, and asymmetrical undead movement. Sparse torn skin, a few exposed bone edges or stitched tears, kept clean and non-gory for coloring.
